params.prompt: Edit only the opening shoe extraction in the supplied Astrid source video, approximately 0.15–0.65 seconds. Preserve the exact Astrid identity, camera, scene, body, shoe, downstream delivery and empty return. Correct the feeding hand so it pulls the single card outward through the existing shoe front opening near felt level instead of lifting it off the inclined stack. Reconnect continuously to the original held-card pose by 0.75 seconds. No second card, extra shoe, body deformation, cut or dissolve. The second and third image references show mechanical action only: fingertips press the leading card down along the inclined front and pull it outward over the low lip while the stack stays fixed. Do not copy reference skin, shoe design, camera or room. Retain Astrid proportions and existing shoe. Show that same card continuously leaving the opening and reaching the original supported pose. After 0.75 seconds preserve the source action and appearance through delivery, release and return.
